title: visual-runtime (π) lane — the fail-CLOSED gate-philosophy foundation

ratifyBeforeImpl.workspaceLocation: tests-visual/ (a package.json workspaces member; private:true; OFF the published dist/exports surface)
ratifyBeforeImpl.headlessDevice: Chrome-headless-new — Playwright's bundled Chromium in the new headless mode, carrying BOTH a WebGL2 backend (ANGLE → SwiftShader software-rasterizer, deterministic on a GPU-less runner) AND a WebGPU backend (Dawn). Launch flags: --headless=new --use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader --enable-unsafe-swiftshader --enable-unsafe-webgpu --enable-features=Vulkan --ignore-gpu-blocklist.
ratifyBeforeImpl.rationale: The aurora WebGL2 + blob WebGL2 surfaces need a real device backend; the SwiftShader software GL gives a deterministic paint on a GPU-less CI runner. The demo dev server already serves the routes. A single headless device covers both the WebGL2 floor (W08) and the WebGPU arm (W07).

blob.config: BLOB_CONFIG_DEFAULTS (mounted directly by the story — zero extra wiring)
blob.assertion: the LOOSE non-flood opaque-fraction band 0.10–0.70 of the canvas (transparent margin survives — catches BOTH the flood→1 and the blank→0)
